name: Ceramic Mug
description: Hand-thrown stoneware mug fired at 2200°F for a finish that only improves with age. The ergonomic handle sits low for a balanced grip, and the 12 oz capacity is the Goldilocks of morning coffee — enough to wake you up, not so much that it goes cold. Each piece carries subtle variations in glaze depth that make it unmistakably yours. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

name: Canvas Tote
description: Built from 12 oz heavyweight cotton canvas that starts stiff and breaks in like a good pair of jeans. The unlined interior swallows a laptop, a week of groceries, or a beach day without complaint. Extended 10" straps clear your shoulder even in a winter coat. Reinforced bottom and bar-tacked stress points mean this bag outlasts trends — and probably your phone.

name: Linen Notebook
description: A5 hardcover bound in Belgian linen with a subtle woven texture that begs to be handled. Opens flat thanks to the lay-flat binding — no cracking the spine or wrestling pages. 192 pages of 100 gsm fountain-pen-friendly paper that handles ink without bleed-through. Ruled interior, ribbon bookmark, and expandable back pocket for loose notes.

name: Photo Preset Pack
description: 10 professionally graded Lightroom presets built for travel, portrait, and lifestyle photography. Each preset is non-destructive, fully customizable, and tuned for natural skin tones across diverse lighting conditions. From warm golden-hour tones to moody desaturated looks — one click and your RAW files go from flat to finished. Works with Lightroom Classic, CC, and mobile. Instant download after purchase.
